Spatialize a polity-level nitrogen total to crops and grid cells.

Source: R/n_balance_spatialize.R
spatialize_country_n_to_crops.Rd

Promotes a single polity-total nitrogen input (one row per year, area_code, for one fertiliser type) to the crop level by the same harvested-area-share logic used by build_crop_soil_n2o_extension() (year/area_code-matched, weighted by each crop's share of harvested cropland area), then optionally further to the grid level by the crop allocation the soil carbon inputs place the same crop by (build_soil_carbon_inputs()'s default method_crop_weights = "spatialized"): each cell's share of the polity-crop's area as the spatialization engine (build_gridded_landuse()) places it that year, a fodder crop the engine leaves out on the fodder layer, the production items of a commodity balance item pooled by their placed hectares. A polity-crop the allocation does not place is spread over the polity's cropland cells, each weighted by its share of the polity's placed crop area, so the grid output still re-aggregates to the polity total. Such reallocations emit a warning naming the affected crops and the reallocated nitrogen. One allocation for nitrogen and carbon means the nitrogen a crop receives in a cell and the carbon it returns there are spread alike (whep#1002).

The allocation is built on the cell support with the polity's share of each cell as its cell_area_frac, because a border cell's cropland belongs to more than one polity. That share is a polycell's land_area_ha over the cell's total land_area_ha, the share of the cell's land build_polycell_support() measures geodesically. The transitional alternative is polity_frac, the subcell-count share build_cell_polity() carries, which is quantised to 1/36 of a cell.

The share is of the cell's land, never land_area_ha / cell_area_ha: what it splits is already land-only, so dividing by the whole cell would remove the inland water and ice a second time. And it is a share, never an absolute area.

Because the cell weights are renormalised within each polity-crop-year, either key redistributes the polity total and neither can change it. Swapping the key moves where the nitrogen lands, never how much of it there is. A pre-built data$crop_allocation is used as supplied, on the support it was built on.

Usage

spatialize_country_n_to_crops(
  country_totals,
  crop_shares,
  cell_polity,
  resolution = c("polity_crop", "grid"),
  split = c("auto", "land_area_ha", "polity_frac"),
  polity_validity = c("keep", "flag", "drop"),
  data = list()
)

Arguments

country_totals

A tibble with year, area_code, n_t: the polity-level nitrogen total for one fertiliser type.

crop_shares

A tibble with year, area_code, item_cbs_code, area_share: harvested-area-weighted crop shares within each country-year, e.g. from build_crop_soil_n2o_extension()'s internal crop-area-share helper.

cell_polity

The cell-to-polity support (lon, lat, area_code, cell_area_ha and the split key column). Only required when resolution includes "grid". Rows are keyed on area_code: build_polycell_support() keys on polity_code and does not derive the reporting vocabulary (DA-23), and polity_area_crosswalk folds distinct polities into one area_code or leaves it NA, so a support must be converted to one row per cell and area_code before it is passed here. That conversion is refused rather than performed silently. The share denominator is the land of the rows supplied, so a caller that simply drops the unkeyable polycells renormalises the survivors onto the whole cell and hands them hectares that are not theirs, invisibly, because the shares still sum to 1. Keep that land in the denominator instead, under a bucket no country_totals row can join: it then dilutes nobody's share and receives no nitrogen.

resolution

Which resolution(s) to return: "polity_crop" (default, year/area_code/item_cbs_code totals only) or "grid" (also distributes to lon/lat grid cells by the crop allocation).

split

Which polity share of the cell weights each grid cell: "auto" (default) takes land_area_ha when the support carries it and polity_frac otherwise; "land_area_ha" and "polity_frac" demand that key and abort when it is absent. The resolved key is recorded in the method_polity_split output column, so a table's split is readable from the table. Read only at resolution = "grid"; the "polity_crop" output splits nothing across cells.

polity_validity

What to do with a row whose (area_code, year) resolves to a polity that did not exist in that year (the cell-polity crosswalk has no year dimension, so an early-20th-century cell is labelled with its present-day territory). "keep" (default) keeps every row, which is the historical behaviour, and warns naming the rows, years and area codes involved. "flag" keeps them and adds the per-row logical reporting_polity_out_of_span, marking exactly which rows are stand-ins. "drop" removes them. All three warn; only "drop" changes the numbers. See polity_coverage_gaps(), which reports the same rows for an already-built table.

data

Optional named list of pre-loaded grid inputs, used only when resolution = "grid": crop_allocation, the crop allocation built once (a list of weights, with lon, lat, area_code, item_prod_code, year, crop_area_ha, area_weight, and fallback, with lon, lat, area_code, year, cropland_weight); else gridded_crops (a build_gridded_landuse() crop-level output), engine_inputs (its country_areas, crop_patterns and gridded_cropland inputs) and fodder_patterns (the fodder layer), each read from its pin when absent. item_cbs_code in crop_shares/country_totals is matched to the allocation's item_prod_code via items_prod_full (the same crosswalk build_crop_land_extension() uses). Supply primary_prod with year, geography, item_prod_code, unit and value to check each production component's harvested-area target. Source and flag columns are retained in the coverage diagnostic. component_policy = "error" (default) rejects missing/conflicting component mappings, invalid or missing targets, or a positive crop component absent from a partly represented CBS group. "legacy_pool" explicitly retains placed-hectare pooling despite those gaps and warns with class whep_crop_component_coverage; its missing_components field identifies the affected source rows. Whole-CBS cropland fallback remains separately reported. Neither policy invents crop-specific support or fills a missing source area with zero. Without production-item targets, coverage is stamped "targets_unavailable", never asserted complete.

Value

A tibble. For resolution = "polity_crop": year, area_code, item_cbs_code, n_t. For resolution = "grid": lon, lat, area_code, year, item_cbs_code, n_t, method_polity_split and method_crop_components. Grid output carries a crop_component_coverage attribute with the supplied targets and their coverage status. "supplied_targets_covered" checks only the supplied component list, not completeness or correctness of the source inventory. Either gains reporting_polity_out_of_span when polity_validity = "flag"; this output carries no reporting-polity columns, so the flag is attached directly rather than derived from them.

Annual keys

Supplied totals, crop shares, allocation tables and primary inventories require finite, nonmissing whole numeric years representable as R integers. Character years are rejected rather than coerced; validate and parse source dates before supplying them. Invalid years cannot be truncated or filtered away to conceal a missing crop component.

Territorial compatibility

This consumer still uses the numeric geography adapter. Distinct supplied reporting polities cannot share an area code within the same year; an ambiguous mapping aborts instead of pooling their observations. Native identity-keyed crop allocations are not yet consumed by this public path. Keep identity columns rather than removing them to bypass these checks; the remaining consumer migration is tracked in issues #1483 and #458.

Examples

spatialize_country_n_to_crops(
  country_totals = tibble::tribble(
    ~year, ~area_code, ~n_t,
    2010L, 10L, 100
  ),
  crop_shares = tibble::tribble(
    ~year, ~area_code, ~item_cbs_code, ~area_share,
    2010L, 10L, 2511L, 0.7,
    2010L, 10L, 2513L, 0.3
  ),
  cell_polity = NULL,
  resolution = "polity_crop"
)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 4
#>    year area_code item_cbs_code   n_t
#>   <int>     <int>         <int> <dbl>
#> 1  2010        10          2511    70
#> 2  2010        10          2513    30
